_nota: Brief do layer de imagem. Consumido por tools/generate-images.mjs. Modelo z_image, 0.15 crédito por peça.
sufixo: Editorial corporate photography, candid documentary moment, well exposed, high key lighting, luminous and airy. Subtle violet #6455D4 and mint #00D294 accents in the scene. Nobody looks at the camera, no posed expressions, no forced smiles. Screens are turned away or heavily out of focus, no readable interface anywhere. Clean uncluttered space in the lower third of the frame. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no signage anywhere in the image.
